concept: Connecting ideas across different subjects or fields to understand something new
source_inspiration: original content, informed by da Vinci's cross-disciplinary legacy — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student is presented with a problem that becomes easier to solve by applying an idea borrowed from a completely different field
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether to stay within the obvious approach or borrow from elsewhere
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what made the cross-field connection useful

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific idea borrowed from a different field and how it applied
